title: mentha longifolia var. planitiensis
intro: Mentha longifolia var. planitiensis, commonly known as Field Balm or Wild Horsemint, is a subspecies of the Mentha longifolia plant, a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Field Balm include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, which help to promote relaxation, ease spasms, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
